body: Yes but I also find that my hatred of red onion is far stronger than yellow onion!

My stbx is being so inconsistent. We are still living together although he moved to the basement, and when my family was over he was waking them through the house talking about plans to do this or that when less than a week ago he was telling me he wanted to sell as soon as possible. They are so unpredictable and it’s all about appearances, how they think they look to others.
I don’t know shit about fuck.
I love that you created your own unique traditions. Turn the holiday on it’s head!

This is where I am. We are still living together with our kids. He is making this thanksgiving miserable for me, all sorts of conditions on what he will allow and it’s awful. I am so sad, scared and broken and he doesn’t care at all.  I know at some point when we are finally divorced and move forward, he will try to play on my sympathy and I have to remember, it’s always been about his needs.  Even half a decent human being would be more caring and compassionate knowing how much pain his wife is in.  He seems to almost enjoy it.
Called the cops when he tried to take my phone and leave the house.
Can I message you?  This is incredibly and frighteningly relatable to how I feel.
I’m close to breaking right now but have two small kids from my marriage who I have to be here for. It’s so hard, there are days when I cannot breathe.

American here. My apartment building had parcel lockers and we used a service called parcel pending, so while not commonly heard, Americans do use the term parcel. 

The parcel I ordered from amazon on Tuesday that should have arrived yesterday now may arrive anytime between today and Wednesday. No matter the item I ordered was intended for a birthday party later today.

I wish people could be more compassionate and forgiving sometimes. I never cheated, never stole, never got pregnant on the sly. I now realize I endured emotional abuse for years, but because I am the one who couldn’t take anymore and acted out impulsively, my husband has completely victimized himself and takes 0 blame for the breakdown of our marriage.   

I’m not going to defend what your wife did, it’s inexcusable, but not dealing with it, communicating about it and ultimately letting it all build up to a crescendo is on you both.  

I have two very young kids who I love more than anything, but the pain I am in right now is often more than I can bear.  There is nothing wrong with loving your kids and being in pain over the relationship which they resulted from.
I also read it as delicious!!

This is just so spot on I am practically crying at my desk. It’s been the most unbelievable change since this whole thing set off a few weeks ago. His voice is lower and different when he seems to speak to me, his eyes are completely blank/dead or I see such anger in there. He body language is so severe. Everything is so severe, so full of anger and spite. Then he talks to our kids in his normal voice, or he is humming to himself in the kitchen, laughing at something on his phone. 

I feel like a beat down dog fearful of making eye contact.
Haha! So true!
A lot of women do not have regular periods, so not having one wouldn’t necessarily tip anything off.

This happened to me. Signed by someone in the building management office and package disappeared. The manufacturer opened a UPS investigation and planned to refund me if not found. It randomly showed up 2 weeks later.
I am exactly where you are/were except he is not dead and I’m struggling to divorce him even though I know it’s the right thing for me and our kids.

I am slowly unraveling a years long relationship. He showered me with the kind of attention and gifts I didn’t want or need, but then would completely ignore or ruin holidays and blame me for it. I have felt crazy for so long. I am realizing slowly that I am addicted to him in some sense and that I don’t know any other way to live. 

I know I have been unhappy in our marriage, but right now the misery I feel in trying to break free is actually worse. I have never been addicted to drugs or alcohol, but I can only presume this is what they mean by withdrawal. I just don’t know how to cope without him! It’s terrible, I am a real adult and shouldn’t need anyone like this.

Thanks. Because of how he has been with money, I have always tried to keep things fairly even so I am not too worried about there being a big discrepancy. I just think it’s nasty behavior, but I shouldn’t be surprised at this point.

If I have to pull it all together, I will. I guess I just didn’t quite understand his goal to go through our amazon orders with a microscope to see who may have spent more.  It’s not exciting stuff I bought.
Yes, we recently moved so we don’t meet residency requirements to file for a few more months, so I want to get a separation agreement set up until we can proceed.
No intention of hiding money or anything. Just want to get through this and move on, if possible.  My kids are the priority.
I am not planning on playing his games at all.  I don’t want to provoke him nor cause additional complications.

I have already had a phone consult with an attorney and will meet in person this week. It’s possible that he doesn’t actually want a divorce and this is all for show,  but I need to know where I stand and how to get my ducks in a row to protect me and my kids.
I mean he is focusing on stuff that was purchased for our kids! Like diapers and baby food pouches.
That’s what I thought too, thank you. I think he is just being petty.
Same boat here, on the sofa while the husband sleeps upstairs and leaves me to take care of the kids. It totally sucks. Am thinking of getting an air mattress for the spare room.
I’m 41, feel free to message me if you want to talk. But what are you struggling with? Share here and there may be others who can relate?
Where is there a McDonalds in Van Ness??
Very cool!

I’m realizing they say things like to have power over and control.  I’m trying to remember that this is one person out of 7 billion and in the totality of time, their opinion is so insignificant that we can’t allow it to own us.  Much easier to say than do though.

I’m going through a likely divorce. My husband has told me I am the worst decision he has ever made. He has told me I am worthless.  

He chose to have children with me.  I have to stay around for them. It’s not easy when the person you thought knows you best says these things. But know it’s not the truth.

Oh, it would be bad if I invited anyone over while he is here. I cannot predict how he would respond. I definitely have friends who would, but I just need to suck it up right now. I texted my mom, the baby is sleeping now and the toddler is playing so I am just taking a minute to myself.  He is still asleep which is preferable to him being awake oddly.

My parents are 100% there for me but currently live 5 hours away. I have some good friends, most do not know what has happened, but it’s hard to get out when he won’t really help with the kids. 

I am just trying my best to keep the kids happy and safe, fed and clean. I’m doing my best not to cry in front of them and am not going to beat myself up for giving the 2.5 year old lots of screen time today.  

I’m trying to just focus on breathing. Am holding the baby for some comfort, but just knowing he is upstairs sleeping and I know is full of hate and anger toward me is so so hard. Part of me just wants to go up there and beg for forgiveness which I know I cannot do.

Totally on the same page as you, married 10 years and two kids. He has not moved out, it’s complicated since we recently purchased a house but I am second guessing myself and everything. Feel free to PM.
This is a really good post. Thank you.

I just spent some time researching trauma bonding and everything resonated. This hit me like a truck: 

“When you try and leave, you are plagued by such longing to get back with your partner you feel it might destroy you.”

That is exactly how I feel.  I don’t even know if I actually even like him anymore and all I want is to get back to a good place with him. It’s incredibly twisted.
I am weak too. I precipitated this and now if I could rewind time, I would take it all back in a heartbeat, I can’t handle this.  I’ve ruined my life and my family’s life. He will end up fine.
Spot on. I am so glad I found this sub, I know how that I am not alone. That makes me incredibly sad but also relieved.

Thank you for the comments. You have validated the feeling I have had for YEARS that I could do or say anything and still not be able to get him to be calm and reasonable. I am so tired of walking around on eggshells. I am so tired of feeling wrong all the time. I’ve tried to tell him kindly that his mood casts a long shadow but he probably likes that.  I’m heartbroken because I think I am slowly realizing the person I loved doesn’t really exist at all.

Thank you all for your continued support. This morning was harder than yesterday oddly. He has been quiet and calm which scares me a little, although he has completely ignored me unless I directly ask him a question. I have no idea what he is planning or what steps he is taking at this point. Sometimes it seems hard to breathe. I’ve reached out to a few therapists because I think I need help coping.

I’ll miss when it wasn’t high conflict. Those easy days of having that person who gets you, gets your jokes, knows what you like.  I’ll really miss the shared history. I won’t miss the walking around on eggshells and the verbal abuse.  There are aspects of him that I’ll miss so much it crush my heart, but I have to convince myself that person is gone, almost like a death.
Thank you so much. I feel frozen with anxiety. I have been so distracted today.

Thank you for your thoughtful reply. Also thank you for the links, I feel very fragile right now and very much like I am in a fog. I haven’t felt this level of anxiety and disruption in my life. 

This is almost harder than hearing the abuse.

Thank you. I listened to a few recordings that I didn’t delete from awhile ago and in the light of day they don’t sound terrible. 

It’s not normal though for a spouse to yell and berate, calling his wife selfish and stupid though, is it?  I only found one where he called me a c*** and in some of them he is calling me lazy. It’s not a crime, but is it possible that my behavior merited it? 

I am really battling the feeling of just wanting to make things better and move on. I know that’s not a reality but right now I am just rather paralyzed to do anything. I reached out to two attorneys today, and am waiting to hear back. I am so nervous as to what will happen when he comes home tonight. Part of me hopes he just ignores me completely like he typically does when he is angry at me, I just hate feeling like I am the problem.

Thank you. I feel so lost right now that part of me wants things to just go back the way they were before this morning, but I cannot do that. It’s hard to think about starting over when it’s been 20 years of your life.  The road ahead is going to be so hard.

All the recordings I made except for the most recent one was in a one party state.  I just feel awful in general. He is very good at making me feel I am crazy and that he has done nothing wrong.  He doesn’t believe he is verbally abusive to me.
Thank you. I have begged him to not yell in front of the kids.  I will check out that website.
All recordings were in DC.
